chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen's Prophecy of Doom: The Bloody Month and the Enigmatic Visitor
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen senses his fate is tied to the fall of half-ancestors. He slaughters 193 young experts, then meets a phantom who asks: what is the opposite of reality?
og_title: Xiao Chen's Fateful Revelry and the Phantom's Illusion
og_description: After a night of feasting, Xiao Chen embarks on a month-long slaughter of cultivators. At the Undying Sect, a mysterious figure questions the nature of reality, hinting at a cosmic destruction to come.
twitter_title: Bloody Month & the Phantom of Reality
twitter_description: Xiao Chen feels his doom approaching and kills 193 experts. A strange visitor asks: is the world an illusion?
